contract: CEA-608 closed captions from ATSC A/53 and SCTE 20 in MPEG-2 video, A/53 SEI in H.264 and HEVC, and SCC files, decoded to ASS with the real_time and data_field options; reference: FFmpeg ccaption
preparation outside the timed operation: open the input, select the video stream and copy the caption data of every picture in the reference's output order and times (SCC: the scc demuxer's packets)

one timed operation: create and open the decoder with the stream's configuration, packet time base and options, decode every prepared packet with one call each, drain, fold every output subtitle and free it, free the decoder
every output subtitle folded: packet index, pts, display start and end, format, and per rectangle its type, position, size, colour count, flags, ARGB palette, index pixels, text and ASS line
exact equality of the fold with the reference on every case; deliberate differences only as listed compatibility exceptions
